dag_infos.description: Taiwan civilian population, labor force and labor-force participation rate by 5-year age group and gender, derived from DGBAS open-data XML counts.

data_infos.name_cn: 勞動力參與率（按年齡組別及性別）
data_infos.source_type: 行政院主計總處人力資源調查 XML
data_infos.dataset_description: 資料集31061提供15歲以上民間人口按15-19、20-24、25-29、30-34、35-39等年齡組及性別的人數，資料集31063提供同口徑勞動力人數。本DAG同時輸出兩個原始count與由分子／分母計算的rate。
data_infos.etl_description: Resolve the live XML download links from the server-rendered data.gov.tw pages, fetch both official sources with a browser User-Agent, parse the annual-plus-monthly period sequence (months following an annual average belong to the following calendar year), resolve age/gender fields by semantic aliases, and derive participation rate as labor-force count divided by civilian-population count. Counts are reconciled separately by cell count and Decimal sum; annual total-age anchors use the three-times-median scale guard. No population scaling or 18-35 estimate is materialized.
